menu.logo.where: Game logo on the menu, big stamp text; \n is the line break

menu.tagline.where: Line under the logo: what the game is, how many players

menu.nameLabel.where: Label above the player name field

menu.namePlaceholder.where: Grey example text inside the name field

menu.defaultName.where: Name used when the player leaves it blank (server adds " 2", " 3" for duplicates)

menu.codePlaceholder.where: Grey text / screen-reader label of the 4-letter room code field

menu.join.where: Button: join a room (menu and invite screen)

invite.sub.where: Invite-link screen: you were invited to room {code}. {code} is pre-escaped HTML markup; keep the placeholder.

error.inMatch.where: Menu error: that room is mid-match

error.full.where: Menu error: room already has 4 players

error.inMatchWait.where: Menu error after opening an invite link (or typing a code) for a room whose match is already running. {code} = room code
error.inMatchWait.id: Room {code} lagi main. Buka link-nya lagi pas udah selesai!

menu.randomNames.where: Not shown as one line: a | separated list of silly nicknames; one is picked at random to prefill the name box on a first visit. Each name max 16 characters, kid-friendly, local flavour
menu.randomNames.id: Si Sandal|Bocil Gesit|Raja Cilok|Ucup Turbo|Mbak Bakso|Jago Tepok|Kancil Kece|Bang Geprek|Dedek Ompol|Mas Kerupuk

error.roomGone.where: Menu error: invite link to a room that no longer exists

error.typedNotFound.where: Menu error after typing a room code that matches no room (likely a typo). {code} = the 4 letters typed
error.typedNotFound.id: Room {code} nggak ada. Cek lagi kodenya!

error.codeShort.where: Menu error when Join is pressed with fewer than 4 letters in the room code box

error.otherTab.where: Menu error: the same room was opened in another browser tab

error.reconnecting.where: Menu error: pressed Create/Join while offline

lobby.title.where: Lobby heading: room {code}. {code} is pre-escaped HTML markup; keep the placeholder.

lobby.sub.where: Lobby subtitle: send the link to friends

lobby.linkLabel.where: Screen-reader label of the invite link field

lobby.copyManual.where: Copy button when the browser blocks copying

lobby.seatCard.where: Small line in a player slot: their card colour ({color} is seat.* in lower case)

lobby.you.where: Marks your own slot in the lobby and the turn order ("· m"); means "you"

lobby.reading.where: Tag under a player who is reading the tutorial (step {n} of {total})

lobby.needMore.where: Start button while alone in the room

seat.black.where: Card colour name: black (upper case; also used lower-cased in lobby.seatCard)

round.sub.where: Round intro: your card colour, win {n} rounds to win the match. {color} is pre-escaped HTML markup; keep the placeholder.

rps.watching.where: Shown to players who are out while two others play rock-paper-scissors

rps.locked.where: After you picked: waiting for the opponent

rps.oppLocked.where: Opponent has picked. {name} is pre-escaped HTML markup; keep the placeholder.

rps.oppChoosing.where: Opponent still picking. {name} is pre-escaped HTML markup; keep the placeholder.

rps.theyWin.where: RPS result: {name} won ({name} is upper-cased HTML)

rps.you.where: Your side label on the RPS reveal ("you")

choose.title.where: RPS winner: go first or let the other go first?

choose.yield.where: Button: let the opponent go first

choose.wait.where: RPS loser waits for {name} to choose

order.sub.where: Turn order: your colour, last one standing wins. {color} is pre-escaped HTML markup; keep the placeholder.

hud.meTag.where: After your own name in the player chips and card labels ("you")

turn.flat.where: Slam-type button: flat slam (PC adds " · Q")

turn.tilt.where: Slam-type button: tilted slam (PC adds " · E")

turn.forced.where: Banner: you must slam (passed last turn)

turn.flying.where: Banner right after your slam: cards flying

turn.waitReplay.where: Banner: waiting for others to watch your slam replay

turn.hintMouse.where: Bottom hint on PC during your turn

turn.hintTouch.where: Bottom hint on phones during your turn

turn.hintForced.where: Bottom hint when forced to slam inside the pink ring

turn.hintSettle.where: Bottom hint: wait for cards to stop

turn.hintOut.where: Bottom hint: you are eliminated, keep watching

turn.tooLate.where: Pop text where the player tapped in the last ~0.6 s of their turn, when a slam can no longer be sent

card.up.where: Label under a card: face up (followed by owner)

card.down.where: Label under a card: face down

card.fallen.where: Label under a card: fell off the table

card.owner.where: Owner after a card label for other players' cards

card.pop.where: Comic "slap!" pop text when a slipper lands (also menu backdrop)

toast.fall.where: Toast (3-4 players): {name} knocked a card off and is out

toast.dropped.where: Toast: other players lost connection; waiting up to 60 s

net.fpsIdle.where: Corner stats: frame rate when the table is idle

result.fall.where: Round end heading: a card fell off

result.fallHow.where: Round end: {name} knocked a card off, out. {name} is pre-escaped HTML markup; keep the placeholder.

result.leftHow.where: Round end: {out} left. {out} is pre-escaped HTML markup; keep the placeholder.

result.captureHow.where: Round end: {by}'s face-up card lies on {out}'s face-down card. {by} and {out} are pre-escaped HTML.

result.roundWinner.where: Round end, after the explanation: {name} wins the round. {name} is pre-escaped HTML markup; keep the placeholder.

match.theyWin.where: Match end heading: {name} won ({name} upper-cased HTML)

match.rematchWaiting.where: Rematch button after pressing: waiting for the others

match.newRoom.where: Match-end button shown instead of Rematch when everyone else has left; makes a fresh room

match.waitingFor.where: Who has not pressed rematch yet. {names} is pre-escaped HTML markup; keep the placeholder.

sound.title.where: Corner button and sound panel heading

sound.aria.where: Screen-reader label of the sound button

sound.music.where: Volume slider: music (label column is 80 px)

meme.perfectVictory.where: Caption on the match-win meme image (Mortal Kombat quote; often kept in English)

meme.trinh1.where: Skill-shot meme, line 1; plays with a Vietnamese voice clip ("what is skill…")

ftue.invite.title.where: Lobby invite card: first time playing?

ftue.invite.sub.where: Lobby invite card: offers a 1-minute tutorial

ftue.invite.yes.where: Invite card button: show me how

ftue.invite.no.where: Invite card button: I already know

ftue.step.where: Tutorial step counter above the title

ftue.step1.p1.where: Tutorial step 1, paragraph 1. May contain … for emphasis; keep tags balanced.

ftue.step1.mineUp.where: Step 1 picture label: your card, face up

ftue.step1.enemyDown.where: Step 1 picture label: enemy card, face down

ftue.step2.p1.where: Tutorial step 2, paragraph 1. May contain … for emphasis; keep tags balanced.

ftue.step2.touch.where: Tutorial step 2, extra paragraph on phones

ftue.step2.reach.where: Step 2 picture label: black ring = your reach

ftue.step2.dropHere.where: Step 2 picture label: slipper lands here

ftue.step3.title.where: Tutorial step 3 title: face up beats face down

ftue.step3.p1.where: Tutorial step 3, paragraph 1. May contain … for emphasis; keep tags balanced.

ftue.step3.p3.where: Tutorial step 3, paragraph 3. May contain … for emphasis; keep tags balanced.

ftue.step3.lose.where: Step 3 picture caption: you get captured

ftue.step3.bothDown.where: Step 3 picture caption: both face down

ftue.step3.bothUp.where: Step 3 picture caption: both face up

ftue.step4.title.where: Tutorial step 4 title: do not knock cards off

ftue.step4.p1.where: Tutorial step 4, paragraph 1. May contain … for emphasis; keep tags balanced.

ftue.step4.slamHere.where: Step 4 picture label: you slam here

ftue.step4.out.where: Step 4 picture stamp: you are out

ftue.step5.title.where: Tutorial step 5 title: a few more tricks

ftue.step5.p1.where: Tutorial step 5, paragraph 1. May contain … for emphasis; keep tags balanced.

ftue.step5.p2.where: Tutorial step 5, paragraph 2. May contain … for emphasis; keep tags balanced.

ftue.pointer.where: First-turn speech bubble pointing next to your card (bubble is 240 px wide). May contain … for emphasis; keep tags balanced.

ftue.confirm.title.where: Start-confirm card: {name} is still reading the tutorial

ftue.confirm.body.where: Start-confirm card: they are at step {n}/{total}; they can finish during the match. May contain … for emphasis; keep tags balanced.

ftue.stashed.where: Bubble by the "?" button when the match starts mid-tutorial. May contain … for emphasis; keep tags balanced.

tip.label.where: Tag in front of in-match tips

tip.flipped.where: Tip: your card just turned face up

tip.threat.where: Tip: face-up enemy card near your face-down card

tip.edge.where: Tip: your card is near the table edge

tip.forced.where: Tip: first forced slam, explains the pink ring

rules.r1.where: Quick rule 1: your face-up on enemy face-down = capture

rules.r2.where: Quick rule 2: enemy face-up on your face-down = captured

rules.r3.where: Quick rule 3: knock a card off = out

rules.r4.where: Quick rule 4: same side or just touching = play on

rules.r5.where: Quick rule 5: just passed = must slam in the pink ring

rules.r6.where: Quick rule 6: 30 s timeout = lose the turn

rules.resume.where: Quick-rules button: resume the tutorial at step {n}

corner.help.where: Screen-reader label of the "?" corner button

corner.info.where: Corner button that opens the info panel

corner.infoAria.where: Screen-reader label of the Info button

corner.lang.where: Screen-reader label of the language picker

info.by.where: Info panel: "a game by {name}". {name} is pre-escaped HTML markup; keep the placeholder.

info.portfolio.where: Info panel: label before the website link

info.contact.where: Info panel: label before the email link

common.close.where: Close button of the info, sound and quick-rules panels

common.listSep.where: Separator between names in a list (e.g. "A, B")

boot.slow.where: Browser too old / game took too long to load (static HTML copy stays Vietnamese if JS never runs)
